text:
isabel: FYI posted postmortem https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2418765432. We have 4 follow-ups: token validation, perms rollback, audit backfill, secrets rota automation. Need owners, ETAs, and 1-line smoke checks. Pattern: recurring TTL drift after deployments.

noah: I'll own token validation (fix race on cache refresh, unify TTLs). ETA: 2026-04-03. Smoke: `pytest tests/unit/test_token_sync.py -q`

fathima: I'll take permissions rollback + add a CI check to prevent cluster-admin binds in svc namespaces. ETA: 2026-04-07. Smoke: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.name|test("svc-"))'`

raj: I'll do audit backfill + add ingestion schema validator to infra. Backfill ETA: 2026-03-31, validator PR ETA: 2026-04-04. Smoke: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit WHERE protoPayload.methodName="Authenticate" AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)`

isabel: Secrets rotation? Who can handle service account keys and HSM import?

fathima: I can coordinate rotation but need infra help for HSM. Plan: staging canary rotate, automation script, update runbook. Rotate ETA: 2026-04-01, runbook by 2026-04-02. Smoke: `kubectl get secret sa-key -n default -o yaml | grep createdAt`

pm-bot: Created ticket SEC-1299: "AuthZ remediation cadence + ownership". Claimed: token-validation (noah), perms-rollback (fathima), audit-backfill (raj), secrets-rotation (fathima). Recurrence: weekly drift job (cron 0 9 * * 1). Link: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-1299

isabel: Consolidated checklist (update ticket when items progress):
- [ ] Token validation unification — noah — due 2026-04-03
- [ ] Permissions rollback + CI guard — fathima — due 2026-04-07
- [ ] Audit backfill + schema validator — raj — due 2026-03-31/2026-04-04
- [ ] Secrets rotation automation + runbook — fathima/infra — due 2026-04-02
- [ ] Weekly drift monitor (alert on TTL drift >10s, missing Authenticate events) — ops (SRE) — recurring weekly

noah: Will add a tiny smoke command to the runbook today and open a PR.

raj: Starting small-staging backfill now, will report errors in SEC-1299 if >3% malformed.

fathima: I'll book a 30m infra handoff for HSM import tomorrow.

isabel: Thanks. We'll review SEC-1299 in next security sync. If blockers, post in #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:
